name: Diamond DA40 / DA62 control stick grip
view: the stick grip from behind and left, as the pilot sees it; forward is left: the contoured grip on the centre stick between the knees, the electric trim rocker on its top under the thumb, the autopilot disconnect / trim interrupt button on the left of the head and the push-to-talk button on the front under the index finger
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the grip's outline and the switch layout reconstructed from the public Diamond DA40 NG and DA62 descriptions (Diamond Aircraft product overviews, the MSFS DA40 and DA62 documentation, Wikipedia) and public photos looked at for proportions; the DA40 NG and DA62 use the same stick grip. Not traced from a photo.
